excerpts.translation:
S. Teclum . Pers. Stem fruticose, roundish with spines;
leaves 2-pinnatifid-sinuate, hairy and with spines on
both sides; berries covered by the hairy calyx. ♂. Fl.
in autumn. - S. fructu tecto. Cav. Ic. 4. t. 309. (v. v. c.)
Gen . LYGOPERSICUM . T. Cal . 5–6 – fid. Cor. in the form
of a wheel with the very short tube and the 5–6 – fid folded limb. Stamens 5-6 inserted in the throat of the
corolla with the almost sessile anthers protruding, reo nided by
their apex, 2-loc. and dehiscent longitudinally by the
inner face. Berry 2-3-locular.
L. Pyriforme. Dun. Pl. covered with various hairs, with
herbaceous stem and leaves unequally pinnate-divided into
segments split glaucous underneath; peduncles and
pedicels without bracts; calycine laciniae almost as long
as the corolla; pyriform or conical berries reversed. O.
Fl. Ag. Set.– Dunal. monog. solan . 112.
t . 26. – Solanum
pomiferum .Cav.y Pers. (v.v. c .)
L. Cerasiforme. Dun. Pl. covered with various hairs with
leaves unequally pinnate-divided into split segments,
glaucous underneath; calycine laciniae almost as long
as the cor. spherical berries. O. Fl. with the anterior, from which it is distinguished only by the shape of
the berries.- Jacq. hort. vindob. 1.
t . 11.-Solanum lyco
persicum . b, L. (v. V. c.)
a. Red berries.
b. Yellow berries.
L. Esculentum. Mill. Hairy herbaceous with leaves unequally pinnate-divided into split segments, glaucous
underneath; flowers gathered in considerable number;
torulose berries. ♂. Fl.
August. - Dunal.monog.

c. Yellow berries.
d. White berries.
Gen. ATROPA, L. Cal. 5-parted. Cor. in the form of
a bell-shaped funnel with the 5-10-tid folded limb.
Stamens 5 inserted in the tube, protruding or barely protruding. Berry 2-loc. reinforced with the patent calyx.
A. Belladona. L. Herbaceous forked stem with
unequal geminate leaves ovate-elliptic acute; peduncles
solitary uniflorous; corolla livid, brown-violet inside.
